messages.subject: Error in A matrix
parts:
Dear INLA group,

I've been working with SPDE Models to interpolate digital terrain data using a high number of covariates. This dataset is relatively big, counting with around 1.5 million rows. So forth I've not had any problems, though now I keep receiving the same Error message when trying to create the A matrix:

 Error in fmesher.read(prefix, "points2mesh.t") : 
 File 'C:\Users\hurie\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpOKLGhm\file1ea436fb1cc7.points2mesh.t' does not exist.

Any ideas on what am I doing wrong?

Thank you in advance,

Huriel Reichel

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error in A matrix
parts:
Hi,

the likely reason is that fmesher (that calculates the mapping between mesh and points) crashed.  Have you tried calling inla.spde.make.A() with a smaller subset of the points? If that works, you can loop over sufficiently small blocks of points, and then aggregate the resulting matrices with rbind().

Finn
